lines.text: Many learners say: He is good at play soccer.
Better: He is good at playing soccer.
Speaking! She is good at speaking English.

data.wrong: He is good at play soccer.
data.right: He is good at playing soccer.

native.hook: at 后面要用 ing 形式！
native.tip: 中文“擅长踢足球”里，动词直接放在“擅长”后面，形式不变。英语里 at 后面的动词要加 ing：good at playing。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “He is good at play soccer.”😅 中文动词不变形，英语 at 后要加 ing：“He is good at playing soccer.”跟着 Carlos 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“He is good at playing soccer.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: Chinese verbs never change shape, but in English a verb after at needs ing.
en.caption: Do you say “He is good at play soccer.” 😅 A verb after at needs ing: “He is good at playing soccer.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
